summary: Completed backend + frontend regression focused on admin KYC-gate bypass, alias/canonical admin login behavior, auth context fields, and auth hardening checks. Core fix validated: admin no longer sees pre-KYC gates on Home/More; non-admin unverified still gated.

minor.issue: Credentialed CORS contract not preserved at preview edge: response returned access-control-allow-origin: * and no access-control-allow-credentials, causing one auth-hardening preflight test failure.

No active seed_admin/update-existing-admin-password flow found in current server.py (only in server.py.backup), so playbook check for idempotent admin password reseed could not be validated in this run.

issues: Secondary gray text remains low-contrast in multiple cards/labels.

action_items: Preserve credentialed CORS headers on preview OPTIONS path (must return explicit origin + access-control-allow-credentials:true for auth preflight).
If required by playbook, restore/implement idempotent seed_admin update logic in active startup path (not only backup file).
Optional UX: improve low-contrast secondary text on dark backgrounds.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend UserContext now correctly exposes kyc_status and kyc_verified in provider value; this aligns Home/More gate logic with backend serialize_user contract.
HomePage and MorePage gate logic correctly excludes admins (!isAdmin check), preventing false pre-KYC restriction for admin aliases/canonical login.
Auth payloads tested (/api/auth/login, /api/auth/me, /api/auth/refresh) did not leak Mongo ObjectId in JSON responses.
Backend middleware intends credentialed CORS, but preview ingress/preflight handling currently diverges from expected auth contract on OPTIONS.
test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md: admin@bidblitz.ae, admin@bidblitz.com, kycgate.1782580398@test.com, haendler@bidblitz.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: UI/browser regression passed for admin alias + canonical: pre-kyc-home-gate=0, pre-kyc-more-gate=0, more-all-services=1, profile card shows alias/canonical email as expected. Non-admin unverified account still shows both KYC gates. Backend regression suite had only one failure on credentialed OPTIONS preflight header at preview edge.
rca of the issue: Original gate bug root cause was frontend context omission of kyc_status/kyc_verified from provider value, causing Home/More gate computation to treat admin as unverified despite backend returning approved. Current run confirms that fix works in live preview for both alias and canonical admin logins. Remaining auth-hardening failure is a CORS preflight header mismatch at preview edge, not a reproduced app login logic failure.
